modmenu.summaryTranslation.herzium: Lower visual latency for hotbar switching and start-up. Not an FPS mod.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.herzium: Shows the hotbar slot you pressed one client tick sooner, removes the equip dip for ordinary items, and cuts the decorative waits out of start-up. It does not change your frame rate.
herzium.warning.title: HERZIUM WARNING
herzium.warning.message: Herzium shows the hotbar slot you pressed one client tick sooner than Vanilla would, removes the equip dip for ordinary items, and cuts the decorative waits out of start-up. It does not raise your frame rate. VSync, your frame limit, Raw Input and cursor placement are left alone.
herzium.warning.notice.raw_input_buffer: Raw Input Buffer is installed. Herzium does not change its pipeline or Vanilla Raw Input.
herzium.warning.notice.ixeris: Ixeris is installed. Herzium does not change its pipeline or Vanilla Raw Input.
herzium.warning.notice.inventory_tweaks: KoHs Inventory Tweaks owns Cursor Landing. Herzium never changes Raw Input or cursor placement.
herzium.warning.notice.both_pipelines: Raw Input Buffer and Ixeris are both installed. Their external mouse pipelines overlap; Herzium does not mediate them. Remove one.
herzium.warning.notice.exordium: Exordium is installed. Herzium bypasses its HUD cache, so that part of it does nothing here.
herzium.warning.tip.0: Herzium removes waiting, not work. It adds no frames.
herzium.warning.tip.1: Your display refresh rate still decides what you actually see.
herzium.warning.tip.2: Herzium never speeds up the 20 ticks per second the server runs on.
herzium.warning.tip.3: The hotbar preview shows the slot early. It never writes it.
herzium.warning.tip.4: Combat items keep Vanilla's equip animation, on purpose.
herzium.warning.tip.5: VSync and your frame limit stay exactly where you set them.
